correctness.rationale: Four low-sum edges form a path on vertices with high-sum component residues M-1,0,M,1 modulo t; a union of shifted matchings has exactly residue-chain components, giving necessary-and-sufficient acyclicity. Every acyclic finite support extends infinitely by adding sums strictly more than twice the prior maximum, yielding the exact word claim under Theorem E. Direct independent finite graph checker passed 7920 pairs; no finite-to-infinite inference.
